q052_five_way_2026_10_19.question: Under the Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1974, what is the maximum penalty for carrying out a polluting process in contravention of an order, and is the offence cognizable?

gold.acceptable_conclusion: Contravention of an order under the Water Act is punishable with imprisonment up to 3 months (5 months for subsequent convictions) and a fine of at least 2000 rupees per day for continuing offences, and is cognizable.

q052_five_way_2026_10_19.design: same top-20 C_hybrid chunks and prompt for all five; candidate rows from model_ab.jsonl, frontier rows from the 2026-10-19 probes, laguna from retry_live.jsonl cond=veto (what ab_model.laguna_base() returns)
